meta.name: YFJS
meta.description:
Adds some stuff I made using JavaScript:
'Potok' (Rus: flow) - Artillery cannon using electricity to shoot liquid capsules
'Serp' (Rus: sickle) - Spider unit that automatically mines titanium, lead and copper and defends with the mining laser
'Uley' (Rus: beehive) - Spore-infested mega with a new artillery turret
'Mycorisa' (Rus: mycoris) - Convers vanilla units to spore-infested units with completely different abilities
